summary: İsmayıllı is a mountain district with an elevation mean of 1118 metres and a population of 87900. The area features a forest landcover of 37.7% and a park density of 17.06 per 10,000 residents, exceeding the national median of 3.89. School density stands at 12.51 per 10,000 residents, while the paved road share of known surfaces is 0.9%. The comfort index is 79 and the infrastructure index is 37 compared to national median 45.
